cues.en: Today, I want to talk a bit about our goals for the PlayStation five hardware and how they influenced the development of the console.
cues.zh: 今天，我想谈谈我们对PlayStation 5硬件的目标，以及这些目标如何影响了主机的开发。

cues.en: I think you all know I'm a big believer in console generations.
cues.zh: 我想你们都知道，我非常信奉主机世代。

cues.en: Once every five or six or seven years, a console arrives with substantially new capabilities.
cues.zh: 每隔五、六或七年，就会有一款具备大幅全新能力的主机问世。

cues.en: There's a lot of learning by the game developers hopefully not too overwhelming

cues.en: Now, it used to be that as a console designer you'd somehow Intuit what would be the best set of capabilities for the new console and then build it in complete secrecy.
cues.zh: 过去，作为主机设计师，你得凭直觉判断新主机的最佳能力组合，然后在完全保密的情况下把它造出来。

cues.en: For the PlayStation consoles that period lasted through PlayStation three,
cues.zh: 对PlayStation主机来说，这个阶段一直持续到PlayStation 3，

cues.en: a powerful and groundbreaking console, but also one that caused quite a lot of heartache as it was initially difficult to develop games for.
cues.zh: 那是一台强大且开创性的主机，但同时也带来了不少痛苦，因为最初很难为它开发游戏。

cues.en: So starting with PlayStation four, we've taken a different approach roughly centered around three principles.
cues.zh: 所以从PlayStation 4开始，我们采取了不同的方式，大致围绕三个原则。

cues.en: The first of these is listening to the developers, which is to say that a lot of what we put into a console derives directly from the needs and aspirations of the game creators.
cues.zh: 第一个原则是倾听开发者，也就是说，我们放进主机里的很多东西，直接源自游戏创作者的需求和愿景。

cues.en: We definitely do have some ideas of our own, but at the core of our philosophy for designing consoles is that game players are here for the fantastic games.
cues.zh: 我们确实有一些自己的想法，但我们设计游戏机的核心理念是，玩家是为了精彩游戏而来的。

cues.en: Which is to say that game creators matter.
cues.zh: 也就是说，游戏创作者很重要。

cues.en: Anything we can do to make life easier for the game creators or help them realize their dreams we will do.
cues.zh: 只要能帮游戏创作者减负或助他们圆梦，我们都会去做。

cues.en: So about once every two years I take a tour of the industry. I go to the various developers and publishers, sit down and discuss how they're doing with the current consoles and what they'd like to see in future consoles.
cues.zh: 大约每两年，我会走访一次业界。去各家开发商和发行商那里，坐下来聊聊他们用现行主机的体验，以及对未来主机的期待。

cues.en: This requires weeks on the road as reaching the bulk of the game creators involves talking to well over a 100 people at something like two dozen publishers and developers
cues.zh: 这得花上数周在路上，因为要接触到大部分游戏创作者，就得和二十多家发行商与开发商的上百人交流

cues.en: and it is incredibly
cues.zh: 这非常有

cues.zh: 顺便说，开发者

cues.zh: 我们很乐意把它放进硬件里，但需要解决很多问题。稍后我会深入讲讲 SSD 和相关系统。

cues.en: It's also key to make a generational leap while keeping the console sufficiently familiar to game developers. I think about this in terms of balancing evolution and revolution.
cues.zh: 在实现世代跨越的同时，让主机对游戏开发者足够熟悉也很关键。我用进化与革命的平衡来考量这件事。

cues.en: Now with PlayStation one two and three the target was a revolution each time with a brand new feature set That was great in many ways, but time for the developers to get up and running got longer with each console in the past I've called this time to triangle
cues.zh: 在 PlayStation 1、2、3 时代，目标是每次来一场革命，带来全新特性。这在很多方面很棒，但开发者上手所需的时间随每代主机越来越长。过去我称这个时间为“到三角形的时长”

cues.en: Here's what I had for those three consoles.
cues.zh: 这是我为那三代主机准备的内容。

cues.en: To be clear, I'm not talking about time to make a game. Developers will be ambitious and it may take them six years or so to realize their vision. What I'm talking about is that dead time before graphics and other aspects of game development are up and running and trying to minimize that.
cues.zh: 明确一下，我说的不是制作一款游戏所需的时间。开发者总是雄心勃勃，实现他们的愿景可能需要六年左右的时间。我要说的是在图形和其他游戏开发环节启动之前的那些空白时间，我们要尽量缩短这段时间。

cues.en: On the other hand, if we're trying to reduce that dead time to zero, that means the hardware architecture can't change at all. We're handcuffed.
cues.zh: 另一方面，如果我们试图将这段空白时间缩短到零，那就意味着硬件架构完全不能变。我们被戴上了手铐。

cues.en: We need to judge for each feature what value it adds and whether it's worth the increase in developer time needed to support it.
cues.zh: 我们需要评估每项功能带来的价值，以及它是否值得投入更多的开发者时间来支持。

cues.en: So with PlayStation four, we were able to strike a pretty good balance between performance and familiarity.
cues.zh: 所以在 PlayStation 4 上，我们在性能和熟悉度之间取得了相当不错的平衡。

cues.en: We got required learning back to PlayStation one levels. With

cues.zh: PS5 上，GPU 绝对是我们感受到最大冲突的领域，一方面要增加新功能，一方面要保持熟悉的编程模型。

cues.en: Ultimately,

cues.en: I think we've ended up with something under a month of getting up to speed that feels like we're striking about the right balance I'll go into a bit more detail later today about our philosophy with the GPU and the specific feature set that resulted from
cues.zh: 我觉得我们把上手时间控制在一个月以内，这感觉达到了很好的平衡。我今天晚些时候会更详细地谈谈我们在 GPU 上的理念以及由此产生的具体功能集。

cues.en: It's also very important for us as the hardware team to find new dreams by which I mean something other than CPU performance GPU performance and the amount of RAM.
cues.zh: 对于我们硬件团队来说，寻找新的梦想也非常重要，我的意思是指除了 CPU 性能、GPU 性能和内存容量之外的东西。

cues.en: The increase in graphics performance over the past two decades has been astonishing, but there are other areas in which we can innovate and provide significant value to the game creators and through them the players. That's why the SSD was very much on our list of directions to explore regardless of what came out of the conversations with game developers and publishers.
cues.zh: 过去二十年里图形性能的提升令人惊叹，但还有其他领域我们可以进行创新，为游戏创作者、并进而为玩家提供巨大的价值。这就是为什么无论与游戏开发者和发行商的交流结果如何，SSD 一直是我们探索方向清单上的重点。

cues.en: The biggest feature in this category is the custom engine for audio That's today's final topic the push for vastly improved audio and in particular three d audio isn't something that came out of the developer meetings It's much more the case that we had a dream of what might be possible
cues.zh: 这一类别中最大的特性是用于音频的自定义引擎这是今天的最后一个话题推动大幅改进的音频，特别是 3D 音频，并不是从开发者会议中诞生的更多的情况是，我们对可能实现的效果怀揣着一个梦想

cues.en: five years from now and then worked out a number of steps we could take to set us on that path
cues.zh: 设想五年后的目标，然后制定出若干步骤，让我们踏上这条道路。

cues.en: So here again are the three principles the first being enabling the desires of developers to drive the hardware design
cues.zh: 所以这里再次重申这三个原则，首先是让开发者的需求来驱动硬件设计

cues.en: To me the SSD really is the key to the next generation It's a game changer and it was the number one ask from developers for PlayStation five as in we know it's probably impossible But can you put an SSD in it?
cues.zh:
对我来说，SSD 真的可以说是下一代的关键所在

cues.en: That was a discussion we were also having internally It was clear that the presence of a hard drive in every PlayStation four was having a positive impact a lot of things that would simply have been impossible at blu ray disc speeds were now possible
cues.zh: 这也是我们内部一直在讨论的问题。很明显，每台 PlayStation 4 都配备硬盘，带来了积极影响：许多在蓝光光盘速度下根本不可能实现的事情，现在都成为可能。

cues.en: at the same time though in 2015 and 2016 when we were having these conversations Developers were already banging up against the limits of the hard drive and a lot of developer time was being spent designing around slow load speeds
cues.zh: 但与此同时，在 2015 和 2016 年我们进行这些讨论时，开发者们就已经在触及硬盘的极限了，并且大量的开发者时间都被花在了围绕缓慢的加载速度进行设计上

cues.en: I Want to focus in on just one number here, which is how long it takes to load a gigabyte of data from a hard drive The difficulty being that hard drives are neither particularly fast nor flexible.
cues.zh:
我想在这里重点关注这一个数字，也就是从硬盘加载一吉字节的数据需要多长时间。
@@
困难在于，硬盘既谈不上多快，也谈不上多灵活。

cues.en: If all your data is in one block, which is frankly not very likely, you can load 50 to a 100 megabytes a second depending on where the data is located on the hard drive. Let's assume it's on the outer edge, which means loading a gigabyte takes ten seconds. If you compress your game packages You can fit more data on the blu ray disc and also effectively boost your hard drive read speed by the compression ratio We support z lib decompression on PlayStation four that gets you something like 50% more data on the disc and 50% higher effective read speed
cues.zh: 如果你的所有数据都在一个块里——老实说这不太可能——那么根据数据在硬盘上的位置，你每秒能加载50到100兆字节。假设数据在外圈，这意味着加载1GB需要十秒。如果你压缩游戏包，你可以在蓝光光盘上放入更多数据，并且通过压缩率有效提升硬盘读取速度。我们在PlayStation 4上支持zlib解压缩，这能让光盘上的数据量增加约50%，有效读取速度提升50%

cues.en: Unfortunately, though, it's highly likely that your data is scattered around in various files on the hard drive as well as sourced from multiple locations within those files So lots of seeks are needed at two to fifty ish milliseconds each
cues.zh: 但不幸的是，你的数据极有可能散布在硬盘上的各个文件中，并且来源于这些文件内的多个位置，因此需要大量寻道，每次大约2到50毫秒

cues.en: My rule of thumb is that the hard drive is spending two thirds of its time seeking and only a third of its time actually loading data
cues.zh: 我的经验法则是，硬盘三分之二的时间花在寻道上，只有三分之一的时间真正在加载数据

cues.en: Putting all of that together a gigabyte is very roughly twenty seconds to load from a hard drive
cues.zh: 综合来看，从硬盘加载1GB大约需要二十秒

cues.en: Now, a gigabyte is not much data. Games are using five or six gigabytes of RAM on PlayStation four, so boot times and load times can get pretty grim. Or to put that differently, as a player, you wait for the game to boot,
cues.zh: 现在，1GB并不算多。游戏在PlayStation 4上使用五六GB的内存，所以启动时间和加载时间会相当糟糕。或者换个说法，作为玩家，你要等游戏启动，

cues.en: Wait for the game to load
cues.zh: 等游戏加载

cues.en: Wait for the level to reload every time you die and you wait for what is euphemistically called fast travel
cues.zh: 每次死亡后等关卡重新加载，还要等那个被委婉称为快速旅行的东西

cues.en: and all of that leads to the dream
cues.zh: 所有这些都指向那个梦想

cues.en: What if we could have not just an SSD?
cues.zh: 如果我们不只有SSD呢？

cues.en: But a blindingly fast SSD SSD if we could load five gigabytes a second from it What would change
cues.zh: 但如果能有一个快得惊人的固态硬盘 SSD，如果我们能以每秒五 gigabytes 的速度从上面加载数据，那会有什么改变？

cues.en: now SSDs are completely different from hard drives They don't have seeks as such if you have a five gigabyte a second SSD You can read data from a thousand different locations in that second pretty much at speed
cues.zh: 现在固态硬盘和硬盘完全不同了，它们本质上没有寻道时间，如果你有一个每秒五 gigabyte 的固态硬盘，你基本上可以在那一秒内以全速从一千个不同的位置读取数据

cues.en: as For time to load a gigabyte. This is next gen we're talking about so memory is bigger instead We should be asking how long to load two gigabytes
cues.zh: 至于加载一个 gigabyte 需要多长时间，我们讨论的是下一代技术，所以内存更大了，相反，我们应该问的是加载两个 gigabyte 需要多久

cues.en: and the answer is about a quarter of a second That's amazing We're talking two orders of magnitude meaning very roughly
cues.zh: 答案大约是四分之一秒，太惊人了，我们说的是两个数量级，也就是说非常粗略地讲

cues.en: times faster
cues.zh: 倍的速度提升

cues.en: Which means at five gigabytes a second for the SSD the potential is that the game boots in a second There are no load screens the game just fades down while loading a half dozen gigabytes and fades back up again same for a reload you're immediately back in the action after you die and Fast travel becomes so fast. It's blinking you miss it as game creators We go from trying to distract the player from how long fast travel is taking like those spider man subway rides to being so blindingly fast that we might even have to slow that transition down
cues.zh: 这意味着在 SSD 达到每秒五 gigabytes 的速度下，游戏的潜在启动时间只需一秒，没有加载界面，游戏在加载区区六个 gigabyte 的同时淡出，然后又淡入，重新加载也是如此，你死后能立即回到战斗中，快速传送变得如此之快，以至于你眨个眼就会错过，作为游戏创作者，我们的做法从试图分散玩家对快速传送耗时的注意力（比如蜘蛛侠的地铁车程），变成了快得眼花缭乱，以至于我们甚至可能不得不把这个过渡放慢

cues.en: Pretty cool. Right? But for me, this is not the primary reason to change from a hard drive to an SSD The primary reason for an ultra fast SSD is that it gives the game designer freedom
cues.zh: 挺酷的，对吧？但对我来说，这并不是从机械硬盘换成固态硬盘的主要原因，超高速固态硬盘的核心优势在于它赋予了游戏设计师自由

cues.en: Or to put that differently with a hard drive the twenty seconds that it takes to load a gigabyte can sabotage the game that the developer is trying to create
cues.zh: 换句话说，在使用机械硬盘时，加载一个 gigabyte 所需的二十秒可能会毁掉开发者苦心孤诣想要打造的游戏

cues.en: I Think almost all of us in the room have experienced this maybe in different ways Say we're making an adventure game and we have two rich environments where we each want enough textures and models to fill memory Which you can do as long as you have a long staircase or elevator ride or a Windy corridor where you can ditch the old assets and then take thirty seconds or so to load the new assets
cues.zh: 我想在座的各位几乎都经历过这种事，只是形式或许不同。假设我们在做一个冒险游戏，里面有两个丰富多彩的环境，我们希望每个环境都有足够填满内存的纹理和模型——只要你有一条长长的楼梯、电梯行程，或者一条弯弯曲曲的走廊，你就能做到这一点，在那里你可以丢弃旧的资源，然后花大约三十秒钟加载新的资源

cues.en: Having a thirty second elevator ride is a little extreme more realistically We'd probably chop the world into a number of smaller pieces and then do some calculations with sight lines and run speeds like we did for Haven City when we were making Jack two. The game is twenty years old, but not much has changed since then. All those twisty passages are there for a reason. There's a whole subset of level design dedicated to this sort of work, but still it's a giant distraction for a team that just wants to make their game
cues.zh: 坐三十秒的电梯有点极端，更现实的做法是，我们可能会把游戏世界切成许多小块，然后结合视线范围和奔走速度做一些计算，就像我们当年制作《杰克2》时处理海文城那样。这游戏都二十年了，但从那以后没太大变化。所有那些曲折的通道存在都是有原因的。有一整类关卡设计就是专门干这种活的，但对一个只想做好游戏的团队来说，这依然是个巨大的分心因素

cues.en: So when I talked about the dream of an SSD part of the reason for that five gigabyte a second target was to eliminate loads But also part of the reason for that target was streaming
cues.zh: 所以当我谈到对 SSD 的梦想时，设定每秒 5GB 这个目标的部分原因是为了消除加载，但这个目标的另一部分原因是为了流式加载

cues.en: as in what if the SSD is so fast that as the player is turning around It's possible to load textures for everything behind the player in that split second If you figure that it takes half a second to turn, that's four gigabytes of compressed data you can load. That sounds about right for next gen.
cues.zh: 也就是说，如果 SSD 够快，当玩家转身时，在极短的一瞬间就能加载玩家身后所有东西的纹理。如果你算一下，转个身需要半秒钟，那你就能加载 4GB 的压缩数据。这听起来非常符合次世代的标准。

cues.en: Anyway, back to the hard drive. Another strategy for increasing effective read speed is to make big sequential chunks of data For example, we might group all the data together for each city block that removes most of the seeks and the streaming gets faster But there's a downside to which is that frequently used data is included in many chunks and therefore is on the hard drive many many times
cues.zh: 言归正传，回到硬盘上来。另一种提高有效读取速度的策略是制作大的连续数据块。例如，我们可以把每个城市街区的所有数据组合在一起，这样就消除了大部分寻道操作，流式加载也变得更快了。但这样做有一个缺点，那就是频繁使用的数据会被包含在许多数据块中，因此会在硬盘上出现很多很多次

cues.en: Marvel spider man uses this strategy and though it works very well for increasing the streaming speed
cues.zh: 《漫威蜘蛛侠》就采用了这种策略，尽管它在提高流式加载速度方面效果非常好

cues.en: There's a massive duplication as a result some of the objects like mailboxes or news racks are on the hard drive 400 times
cues.zh: 但随之而来的是大量的数据重复，像邮箱或报摊这样的物体在硬盘上竟然出现了 400 次

cues.en: What I'm describing here are things that cramp a creative director style either level design gets a little bit boring in places or the data is duplicated so many times that it no longer fits on the blu ray disc and you end up with hard limits on the players run speed or driving speed the player can't go faster than the load speed from the hard drive
cues.zh: 我在这里描述的这些问题，正是那些限制创意总监发挥的地方：要么是关卡设计在某些地方变得有点枯燥，要么是数据被复制了太多次，以至于再也放不下蓝光光盘了，最后导致玩家的奔跑速度或驾驶速度受到硬性限制——玩家的速度不能超过从硬盘加载的速度

cues.en: and Finally, I'm sure many of you have noticed that after a patch download the PlayStation four will sometimes take a long time to install the patch
cues.zh: 最后，我确信你们很多人都注意到，在下载补丁后，PlayStation 4 有时需要很长时间来安装补丁

cues.en: That's because when just part of a file has been changed the new data can be downloaded pretty quickly But before the game boots up a brand new file has to be constructed that includes the changed portion Otherwise, every change would add a seek or two
cues.zh: 这是因为当文件只有一部分发生更改时，新数据可以很快下载下来，但在游戏启动之前，必须构建一个包含更改部分全新文件。否则，每一次更改都会增加一两次寻道操作

cues.en: Even so you can occasionally see this happening on game titles. They start to hitch once they get patched enough
cues.zh: 即便如此，你偶尔还是能在一些游戏大作中看到这种情况发生，当它们打的补丁够多时，就会开始出现卡顿

cues.en: With an SSD though no seeks so no need to make brand new files with the changes incorporated into them, which means no installs as you know them today
cues.zh: 不过有了 SSD 就不一样了，没有寻道操作，所以不需要制作包含更改内容的全新文件，这意味着不再会有你今天所熟知的那些漫长安装过程

cues.en: For PlayStation five, our goal was not just that the SSD itself be a 100 times faster. It was that game loads and streaming would be a 100 times faster. So every single potential bottleneck needed to be addressed, and there are a lot of them.

cues.en: Let's look at check-in and what happens when its overhead gets a 100 times larger. Conceptually check-in is a pretty simple process data is loaded into system memory from the hard drive or SSD It's examined a few values are tweaked to check it in and then it's moved to its final location at the SSD speeds We're talking about that last part moving the data meaning copying it from one location to another Takes roughly an entire next gen CPU core and that's just the tip of the iceberg if all the overheads get a 100 times larger that will cripple the frame rate as soon as the player moves and that massive stream of data starts coming off the SSD.
cues.zh: 我们来看看检入，以及当它的开销增大100倍时会发生什么。从概念上讲，检入是一个相当简单的过程：数据从硬盘或SSD加载到系统内存中，经过检查，调整几个值以完成检入，然后以SSD的速度移动到最终位置。我们说的是最后一部分——移动数据，也就是将其从一个位置复制到另一个位置——大约需要占用一整个下一代CPU核心，而这只是冰山一角。如果所有开销都增大100倍，那么一旦玩家移动，大量数据流开始从SSD涌出，帧率就会立刻崩溃。

cues.en: So to solve all of that, we built a lot of custom hardware, namely a custom flash controller and a number of custom units in our main chip.

cues.en: Now, backwards compatibility was handled masterfully by AMD. They treated it as a key need throughout the design process. As our solution to adding new features without blindsiding developers, we made sure that if there were new significant features,
cues.zh: AMD 对向后兼容性的处理非常出色。他们在整个设计过程中都把它当作关键需求。作为我们添加新功能又不让开发者措手不及的方案，我们确保如果有重要的新功能，

cues.en: it would be optional to use them. The GPU supports ray tracing, but you don't have to use ray tracing to make your game. The GPU supports primitive shaders, but you can release your first game on PlayStation five without making any use of them. Before I get into the capabilities of the GPU. I'd like to make clear two points that can be quite confusing
cues.zh: 使用它们是可选的。GPU 支持光线追踪，但你不必用光线追踪来做游戏。GPU 支持图元着色器，但你完全可以在 PlayStation 5 上发布你的第一款游戏而不使用它们。在讲 GPU 的能力之前，我想先澄清两点，这两点可能会让人相当困惑

cues.en: First we have a custom AMD GPU based on their RDNA two technology.
cues.zh: 首先，我们有一款定制的AMD GPU，基于他们的RDNA 2技术。

cues.en: What does that mean?
cues.zh: 那意味着什么？

cues.en: AMD is continuously
cues.zh: AMD正在不断

cues.en: improving and revising their tech for RDNA two their goals were roughly speaking to reduce power consumption by re architecting the GPU to put data close to where it's needed to optimize the GPU for performance and to add a new more advanced feature set
cues.zh: 改进和修订他们的RDNA 2技术，他们的目标大致是通过重新架构GPU，将数据放在需要的地方附近，以降低功耗，优化GPU性能，并添加一套新的更高级功能。

cues.en: But that feature set is malleable
cues.zh: 但那套功能是可塑的

cues.en: which is to say that we have our own needs for PlayStation and that can factor into what the AMD roadmap becomes so Collaboration is born if we bring concepts to AMD that are felt to be widely useful Then they can be adopted into our DNA too and used broadly including in PC GPUs
cues.zh: 也就是说，我们对PlayStation有自己的需求，这可以影响AMD路线图的发展，因此合作就诞生了。如果我们把被认为广泛有用的概念带给AMD，那么它们也可以被采纳进我们的DNA中，并广泛使用，包括在PC GPU中。

cues.en: if the ideas are sufficiently specific to what we're trying to accomplish like the GPU cash scrubbers I was talking about then they end up being just for us if you see a similar discrete GPU Available as a PC card at roughly the same time as we release our console That means our collaboration with AMD succeeded,
cues.zh: 如果这些想法足够针对我们想要实现的目标，比如我提到的GPU缓存清理器，那么它们最终就只属于我们。如果你看到一款类似的独立GPU在我们发布主机的大致同一时间作为PC卡上市，那意味着我们与AMD的合作成功了，

cues.en: in producing technology useful in both worlds. It doesn't mean that we as Sony simply incorporated the PC part into our console.
cues.zh: 生产出了在两种世界都有用的技术。这并不意味着我们索尼只是把PC部件整合进了我们的主机。

cues.en: This continuous improvement in AMD technology means it's dangerous to rely on teraflops as an absolute indicator of performance and cu count should be avoided as well in the case of CPUs We all understand this the PlayStation four and PlayStation five each have eight CPUs, but we never think that meant the capabilities and performance are equal It's the same for cus for one thing. They've been getting much larger over time adding new features means adding lots of transistors
cues.zh: AMD技术的这种持续改进意味着，依赖teraflops作为性能的绝对指标是危险的，CU数量也应避免作为指标。在CPU的情况下，我们都理解这一点：PlayStation 4和PlayStation 5各有八个CPU，但我们从不认为这意味着能力和性能相等。对CU来说也是一样。首先，它们随着时间推移变得大得多，添加新功能意味着添加大量晶体管。

cues.en: In fact, the transistor count for a PlayStation five cu
cues.zh: 事实上，PlayStation 5 CU的晶体管数量

cues.en: is 62%
cues.zh: 比PlayStation 4 CU的晶体管数量

cues.en: larger than the transistor count for a PlayStation four cu
Second the PlayStation five GPU is backwards compatible with PlayStation four. What does that mean?
cues.zh: 其次，PlayStation 5 GPU向后兼容PlayStation 4。那意味着什么？

cues.en: One way you can achieve backwards compatibility
cues.zh: 实现向下兼容的一种方法

cues.en: is to put the previous consoles chipset in the new console like we did with some PlayStation threes, but that's of course extremely
cues.zh: 是将上一代主机的芯片直接放进新主机里，就像我们在某些 PlayStation 3 上做的那样，但这样做当然极其

cues.en: expensive.
cues.zh: 昂贵。

cues.en: A better way is to incorporate any differences in the previous consoles logic into the new consoles custom chips. Meaning that even as the technology evolves, the logic and feature set that PlayStation four and PlayStation four Pro titles rely on is still available in backwards compatibility modes.
cues.zh: 更好的办法是将上一代主机逻辑中的各种差异整合进新主机的定制芯片中。这意味着，即便技术在不断演进，PlayStation 4 和 PlayStation 4 Pro 游戏所依赖的逻辑和功能集在向下兼容模式下依然可用。

cues.en: One advantage of this strategy is that once backwards compatibility is in the console, it's in. It's not as if a cost down will remove backwards compatibility like it did on PlayStation three.
cues.zh: 这种策略的一个优点是，一旦向下兼容功能做进了主机里，它就固定下来了。不像 PlayStation 3 那样，后续的降本改版会把向下兼容功能给去掉。

cues.en: Achieving this unification of functionality took years of efforts by AMD as any roadmap advancement creates a potential divergence in logic.
cues.zh: 实现这种功能上的统一花费了 AMD 多年的心血，因为路线图的任何推进都会导致逻辑上产生潜在的分歧。

cues.en: Running p s four and p s four titles at boosted frequencies has also added complexity. The boost is truly massive this time around and some game code just can't handle it Testing has to be done on the title by title basis
cues.zh: 以更高的频率运行 PS4 和 PS4 游戏也增加了复杂性。这次的频率提升幅度非常巨大，以至于某些游戏代码根本无法处理，我们必须针对每款游戏进行逐一测试

cues.en: Results
cues.zh: 不过测试

cues.en: are excellent though. We recently took a look at the top 100 PlayStation four titles as ranked by playtime and we're expecting almost all of them to be playable at launch on PlayStation five.
cues.zh: 结果非常出色。我们最近审查了按游玩时间排名的前 100 款 PlayStation 4 游戏，预计几乎所有这些游戏在 PlayStation 五发售时都能游玩。

cues.en: With regards to new features as I said, our strategy was to try to break new ground, but at the same time not to require use of the new GPU capabilities.
cues.zh: 关于新功能，正如我所说，我们的策略是开拓创新，但同时又不需要开发者必须使用新的 GPU 功能。

cues.en: For more than a decade GPUs have imposed a restriction on game engines.
cues.zh: 十多年来，GPU 一直对游戏引擎施加着某种限制。

cues.en: Software handles vertex processing, but for the most part dedicated hardware is responsible for the triangles and other geometry that the vertices form.
cues.zh: 软件负责处理顶点，但三角形以及顶点构成的其他几何体主要由专用硬件负责。

cues.en: That means it's not possible to do even basic optimizations
cues.zh: 这意味着甚至连一些基础的优化都无法做到，

cues.en: such as aborting processing of a vertex if all geometry that uses it is off screen.
cues.zh: 例如，如果使用某个顶点的所有几何体都在屏幕外，就中止该顶点的处理。

cues.en: PlayStation five has a new unit called the geometry engine, which brings handling of triangles and other primitives under full programmatic control.
cues.zh: PlayStation 5 拥有一个名为几何引擎的新单元，它将三角形和其他图元纳入了完全可编程的控制之下。

cues.en: As a game developer, you're free to ignore its existence and use the PlayStation five GPU as if it were no more capable than the psus for GPU,
cues.zh: 作为游戏开发者，你可以选择忽略它的存在，把 PlayStation 5 GPU 当作跟 PS4 GPU 差不多能力的硬件来用，

cues.en: or You can use this new intelligence in various ways
cues.zh: 或者你也可以通过各种方式利用这种全新的智能特性。

cues.en: Simple usage could be performance optimizations such as removing back faced or off screen vertices and triangles
cues.zh: 简单的用法可以是性能优化，比如剔除背面朝向或屏幕外的顶点和三角形。

cues.en: More complex usage involves something called primitive shaders, which allow the game to synthesize geometry on the fly as it's being rendered. It's a brand new capability.
cues.zh: 更复杂的用法涉及一种叫作基元着色器的技术，它允许游戏在渲染时动态合成几何体。这是一个全新的特性。

cues.en: Using primitive shaders on PlayStation five will allow for a broad variety of techniques,
cues.zh: 在 PlayStation 5 上使用基元着色器将带来丰富多样的技术，

cues.en: including smoothly varying level of detail, addition of procedural detail to close-up objects, and improvements to particle effects and other visual special effects.
cues.zh: 包括平滑过渡的细节层次（LOD）、为特写物体添加程序化细节，以及对粒子效果和其他视觉特效的改进。

cues.en: Another major new feature of our custom RDNA two based GPU is ray tracing using the same strategy as AMD's upcoming PC GPUs.
cues.zh: 我们基于定制 RDNA 2 的 GPU 的另一个重大新特性是光线追踪，它采用了与 AMD 即将推出的 PC GPU 相同的策略。

cues.en: The cus contain a new specialized unit called the intersection engine, which can calculate the intersection of rays with boxes and triangles.
cues.zh: CUs 包含一个名为相交引擎的新型专用单元，它可以计算光线与盒子和三角形的相交。

cues.en: To use the intersection engine,
cues.zh: 要使用相交引擎，

cues.en: first you build what is called an acceleration structure.
cues.zh: 首先需要构建所谓的加速结构。

cues.en: It's data in RAM that contains all of your geometry.
cues.zh: 这是存在于内存中的数据，包含你所有的几何体。

cues.en: There's a specific set of formats you can use their variations on the same BVH concept.
cues.zh: 你可以使用一组特定的格式，它们是同一 BVH 概念的变体。

cues.en: Then in your shader program, you use a new instruction that asks the intersection engine to check array against the BVH.
cues.zh: 然后在你的着色器程序中，使用一条新指令，让相交引擎针对 BVH 检查光线。

cues.en: While the intersection engine is processing the requested ray triangle or ray box intersections, the shaders are free to do other work. Having said that, the ray tracing instruction is pretty memory intensive, so it's a good mix with logic heavy code.
cues.zh: 当相交引擎处理请求的光线-三角形或光线-盒子相交时，着色器可以自由地做其他工作。话虽如此，光线追踪指令非常消耗内存，所以它与逻辑密集型代码搭配得很好。

cues.en: There's of course no need to use ray tracing. PS four graphics engines will run just fine on PlayStation five, but it presents an opportunity for those interested.
cues.zh: 当然，并不需要使用光线追踪。PS4 图形引擎在 PlayStation 5 上也能正常运行，但这为感兴趣的人提供了一个机会。

cues.en: I'm thinking it'll take less than a million rays a second to have a big impact on audio. That should be enough for audio occlusion and some reverb calculations.
cues.zh: 我认为每秒不到一百万条光线就能对音频产生很大影响。这应该足以进行音频遮挡和一些混响计算。

cues.en: With a bit more of the GPU invested in ray tracing, it should be possible to do some very nice global illumination.
cues.zh: 如果投入更多 GPU 资源用于光线追踪，应该有可能实现一些非常出色的全局光照。

cues.en: Having said that,
cues.zh: 话虽如此，

cues.en: adding ray traced shadows and reflections to a traditional graphics engine could easily take hundreds of millions of rays a second and full ray tracing could take billions. How far can we go? I'm starting to get quite bullish. I've already seen a PlayStation five title that's successfully using ray tracing based reflections in complex animated scenes with only modest costs.
cues.zh: 向传统图形引擎添加光线追踪阴影和反射，很容易需要每秒数亿条光线，而完整的光线追踪可能需要数十亿条。我们能走多远？我开始变得相当乐观了。我已经看到一款 PlayStation 5 游戏在复杂的动画场景中成功使用了基于光线追踪的反射，而且成本仅适中。

cues.en: Another set of issues for the GPU
cues.zh: GPU 还有另一组问题

cues.en: involved size and frequency.
cues.zh: 涉及规模和频率。

cues.en: How big do we make the GPU and what frequency do we run it at? This is a balancing act. The chip has a cost and there's a cost for whatever we use to supply that chip with power and to cool it. In general, I like running the GPU at higher frequency. Let me show you why.
cues.zh: GPU 做多大、跑多高频率？这是个平衡问题。芯片本身有成本，供电和散热也都有成本。总的来说，我喜欢让 GPU 跑更高频率。我来解释为什么。

cues.en: Here's two possible configurations for a GPU roughly of the level of the PlayStation four Pro. This is a thought experiment. Don't take these configurations too seriously.
cues.zh: 这里有两个大致相当于 PlayStation 4 Pro 级别的 GPU 配置方案。这是个思想实验，别太当真。

cues.en: If you just calculate teraflops,
cues.zh: 如果只算 teraflops，

cues.en: you get the same number.
cues.zh: 数字是一样的。

cues.en: But actually the performance is noticeably different because teraflops is defined as the computational
cues.zh: 但实际上性能有明显差异，因为 teraflops 定义的是向量 ALU 的

cues.en: capability of the vector ALU.
cues.zh: 计算能力。

cues.en: That's just one part of the GPU There are a lot of other units and those other units all run faster when the GPU frequency is higher
cues.zh: 那只是 GPU 的一部分，还有很多其他单元，而这些单元在 GPU 频率更高时都会跑得更快

cues.en: at 33%
cues.zh: 频率高 33%，

cues.en: higher frequency Rasterization
cues.zh: 光栅化

cues.en: goes 33%

faster Processing the command buffer goes that much faster the l two and other caches have that much higher bandwidth and so on About the only downside is that system memory is 33% further away in terms of cycles But the large number of benefits more than counterbalance that as a friend of mine says a rising tide lifts all boats
cues.zh: 命令缓冲区的处理也快那么多，L2 和其他缓存的带宽也高那么多，等等。几乎唯一的缺点是系统内存按周期算远了 33%。但大量的好处远远盖过了这一点。就像我朋友说的，水涨船高。

cues.en: Also, it's easier to fully use 36 cus in parallel than it is to fully use 48 cus when triangles are small It's much harder to fill all those cus with useful work
cues.zh: 而且，三角形较小时，要并行用满 36 个 CU 比用满 48 个 CU 更容易。要用有用的工作填满那么多 CU 难得多。

cues.en: So there's a lot to be said for faster assuming you can handle the resulting power and heat issues Which frankly we haven't always done the best job at Part of the reason for that is historically,
cues.zh: 所以更高频率很有道理，前提是能处理随之而来的功耗和散热问题。坦白说，我们这方面一直做得不够好。部分原因是历史上，

cues.en: our process for setting CPU and GPU frequencies has relied on some heavy duty guesswork with regards to how much electrical power games will consume and how much heat will be produced as a result inside of the console.
cues.zh: 我们设定 CPU 和 GPU 频率的流程，一直依赖大量猜测，猜游戏会消耗多少电、主机内因此产生多少热。

cues.en: Power consumption varies a lot from game to game. When I play God of War on my p s four Pro, I know the power consumption is high just by the fan noise.
cues.zh: 不同游戏的功耗差异很大。当我在 PS4 Pro 上玩《战神》时，光听风扇噪音我就知道功耗很高。

cues.en: But power isn't simply about engine quality. It's about the minutiae of what's being displayed and how. It's counterintuitive
cues.zh: 但强大的性能不仅仅取决于引擎质量。它还关乎展示内容的细节以及展示的方式。这与直觉相悖

cues.en: But processing dense geometry typically consumes less power than processing simple geometry,
cues.zh: 但处理密集几何图形通常比处理简单几何图形消耗更少的电量，

cues.en: which is I suspect why horizons map screen with its low triangle count makes my p s four pro heat up so much
cues.zh: 我猜这也是为什么《地平线》的地图界面三角形数量那么少，却会让我的 PS4 Pro 发热那么厉害。

cues.en: Our process on previous consoles has been to try to guess what the maximum power consumption during the entire console lifetime might be Which is to say the worst case scene in the worst case game and Prepare a cooling solution that we think will be quiet at that power level
cues.zh: 我们以往在主机上的做法是，试着推测主机整个生命周期内的最大功耗可能是多少，也就是最坏游戏里的最坏场景，然后准备一套我们认为在该功耗水平下依然安静的散热方案。

cues.en: If we get it right fan noise is minimal if we get it wrong the console will be quite loud for the higher power games and there's even a chance that it might overheat and shut down if we merestimate power too badly.
cues.zh: 如果判断准确，风扇噪音就会很小；一旦判断失误，运行高功耗游戏时主机就会相当吵，而且如果功耗估计错得太离谱，甚至可能过热关机。

cues.en: PlayStation five is especially challenging because the CPU supports 256
cues.zh: PlayStation 5 尤其具有挑战性，因为其 CPU 支持 256

cues.en: bit native instructions that consume a lot of power. These are great here and there, but presumably only minimally used
cues.zh: 消耗大量电力的位原生指令。这些指令偶尔很好用，但想必只会被极少使用。

cues.en: or Are they if we plan for major 256
cues.zh: 或者如果我们计划进行重大的 256 升级，它们会是这样吗

cues.en: bit instruction usage? We need to set the CPU clock substantially lower or noticeably increase the size of the power supply and fan
cues.zh: 位指令的使用情况？我们需要大幅降低 CPU 时钟频率，或者显著增加电源和风扇的尺寸

cues.en: So after much discussion, we decided to go with a very different direction on PlayStation five.
cues.zh: 经过多次讨论，我们决定在PlayStation 5上采取完全不同的方向。

cues.en: We built a GPU with 36 cus.
cues.zh: 我们造了一款拥有 36 个计算单元（CU）的 GPU。

cues.en: Mind you our DNA to cus are large each has 62% more transistors than the cus we were using on PlayStation four So if we compare transistor counts 36 rDNA to cus equates to roughly 58 PlayStation four cus it is a fairly sizable
cues.zh: 请注意，我们的 rDNA 计算单元体量很大，每个单元的晶体管数量比我们在 PlayStation 4 上使用的计算单元多 62%。因此，如果对比晶体管数量，36 个 rDNA 计算单元大致相当于 58 个 PlayStation 4 计算单元，这是一个相当大的规模。

cues.en: GPU
cues.zh: GPU

cues.en: Then we went with a variable frequency strategy for PlayStation five, which is to say we continuously
cues.zh: 然后，我们在 PlayStation 5 上采用了一种可变频率策略，也就是说我们持续不断地

cues.en: run the GPU and CPU in boost mode We supply a generous amount of electrical power and then increase the frequency of GPU and CPU until they reach the capabilities of the system's cooling solution.
cues.zh: 让 GPU 和 CPU 在加速模式下运行。我们提供充足的电力，然后不断提高 GPU 和 CPU 的频率，直到达到系统散热方案的极限能力。

cues.en: It's a completely different paradigm rather than running at constant frequency and letting power vary based on the workload. We run at essentially constant power and let the frequency bay vary based on the workload.
cues.zh: 这是一种完全不同的范式，不再是保持恒定频率并让功耗随工作负载而波动，而是基本上保持恒定功耗，让频率随工作负载而波动。

cues.en: We then tackle the engineering challenge of a cost effective and high performance cooling solution designed for that specific power level in some ways It becomes a simpler problem because there are no more unknowns. There's no need to guess what power consumption the worst case game might have
cues.zh: 接着，我们攻克了针对该特定功耗水平设计高性价比且高性能散热方案的工程挑战。在某些方面，这变成了一个更简单的问题，因为不再有未知因素。我们不需要去猜测最极端的游戏可能会消耗多少电量。

cues.en: As for the details of the cooling solution, we're saving them for our teardown. I think you'll be quite happy with what the engineering team came up with.
cues.zh: 至于散热方案的细节，我们将留到拆解时再公开。我想工程团队的设计一定会让大家非常满意。

cues.en: So how fast can we run the GPU and CPU with this strategy?
cues.zh: 那么，采用这种策略后，GPU 和 CPU 的运行速度能达到多快呢？

cues.en: The simplest approach would be to look at the actual temperature of the silicon die and throttle the frequency on that basis But that won't work it fails to create a consistent PlayStation five experience
cues.zh: 最简单的方法是观察硅晶圆的实际温度，并以此为基础来动态降频。但这行不通，它无法营造出一致的 PlayStation 5 体验。

cues.en: It wouldn't do to run a console slower simply because it was in a hot room
cues.zh: 不能仅仅因为主机放在闷热的房间里就让它运行变慢。

cues.en: So rather than look at the actual temperature of the silicon die We look at the activities that the GPU and CPU are performing and set the frequencies on that basis which makes everything deterministic
cues.zh: 因此，我们不去看硅晶圆的实际温度，而是观察 GPU 和 CPU 正在执行的操作，并据此设定频率，这使得一切都具有确定性

cues.en: and repeatable
cues.zh: 且可重复

cues.en: While we're at it, we also use amd smart shift technology and send any unused power from the CPU to the GPU so it can squeeze out a few more pixels
cues.zh: 趁着这个机会，我们还使用了 AMD SmartShift 技术，将 CPU 未使用的任何电力输送给 GPU，以便它能多挤出几个像素。

cues.en: The benefits of this this strategy are quite large
cues.zh: 这种策略的好处非常巨大。

cues.en: Running a GPU at two gigahertz was looking like an unreachable target with the old fixed frequency strategy

cues.zh: 我们三项原则的最后一项是关于寻找新的梦想。对硬件团队来说，找到扩展或深化游戏的新方式很重要，这促使我们聚焦于三维音频。

cues.en: As players, we experience the game through the visuals, through audio, and through the feedback we receive from the controller, such as rumble or haptics.
cues.zh: 作为玩家，我们通过画面、通过音频，以及通过手柄传来的反馈（如震动或触觉）来体验游戏。

cues.en: At the same time the audio team on a game project has to do a lot with a little for example on PlayStation four There's fierce competition for the Jaguar CPU course audio typically ends up getting just a fraction of a core
cues.zh: 与此同时，游戏项目的音频团队必须用很少的资源做很多事。例如在 PlayStation 4 上，Jaguar CPU 核心的竞争很激烈，音频通常只能分到一小部分核心。

cues.en: That's not much of a computational resource, particularly when you consider that the visuals run at 30 or 60 frames a second, but audio processing needs to happen at almost 200 times a second.
cues.zh: 这算不上多少计算资源，尤其考虑到画面以每秒 30 或 60 帧运行，而音频处理需要以几乎每秒 200 次的频率进行。

cues.en: So it's been tough going making forward progress on audio with PlayStation four, particularly when PlayStation three was such a beast when it came to audio.
cues.zh: 所以在 PlayStation 4 上推进音频开发一直挺艰难的，尤其是当 PlayStation 3 在音频方面曾是个不折不扣的怪兽时。

cues.en: The SPUs and cell were almost a perfect device for audio rendering. Simple pipelined algorithms could really take advantage of asynchronous DMA and frequently reached a 100% utilization of the floating point unit. There's unfortunately nothing comparable on PlayStation four.
cues.zh: SPU 和 Cell 架构简直是音频渲染的完美设备。简单的流水线算法能够充分利用异步 DMA，浮点运算单元的使用率经常能达到 100%。遗憾的是，PlayStation 4 上没有什么能与之相比。

cues.en: Probably the most dramatic progress in the PlayStation four generation has been with virtual reality

cues.zh: 话虽不能说得太简单，

cues.en: but here were our goals for audio on PlayStation five.
cues.zh: 但这就是我们在 PlayStation five 上的音频目标。

cues.en: The first goal was great audio for everyone not just VR users or soundbar owners or headphone users That meant audio had to be part of the console. It couldn't be a peripheral
cues.zh: 第一个目标是为每个人提供出色的音频，而不仅仅是 VR 用户、条形音响拥有者或耳机用户。这意味着音频必须是主机的一部分，不能只是个外设。

cues.en: The second goal was to support hundreds of sound sources We didn't want developers to have to pick and choose what sounds would get three d effects and which wouldn't we wanted every sound in the game to have dimensionality
cues.zh: 第二个目标是支持数百个声源。我们不想让开发者在哪些声音有 3D 效果、哪些没有之间做取舍，我们希望游戏中的每一个声音都具有空间感。

cues.en: and Finally we wanted to really take on the challenges of presence
cues.zh: 最后，我们希望真正应对沉浸感

cues.en: and Locality
cues.zh: 与定位感的挑战。

cues.en: now when we say presence we mean the feeling that you're actually there you've entered the matrix
cues.zh: 说到沉浸感，我们的意思是让你感觉自己真的身临其境，仿佛进入了黑客帝国。

cues.en: It's not of course something we thought we could perfectly achieve the idea was that if we stopped using just a rain sound and instead used lots of three d audio sources for raindrops hitting the ground and all sorts of locations around you, then at some point your brain would take a leap and you'd begin to have this feeling.
cues.zh: 当然，这并不是说我们认为能完美实现这一点，我们的想法是：如果我们不再只用单一的雨声音效，而是为雨滴落在你周围各个位置使用大量 3D 声源，那么在某个时刻，你的大脑就会产生跨越，开始获得这种真实感。

cues.en: This feeling of a real presence inside the virtual world of the game.
cues.zh: 这种在游戏虚拟世界中真实存在的沉浸感。

cues.en: This has the capacity to affect your appreciation of the game just like music in a game does.
cues.zh: 这能像游戏里的音乐一样影响你对游戏的体验。

cues.en: The concept of locality is simpler. It's just your sense of where the audio is coming from to the right of you, behind you, above you. This can immerse you further in the game, and it can also directly enhance the gameplay
cues.zh: 定位感的概念更简单。它就是你对声音来自何方的感知——在右边、在后面、在上方。这能让你更沉浸于游戏，也能直接增强游戏玩法。

cues.zh: 那么，我们究竟是如何辨别声音是从哪里发出来的呢？

cues.en: Well, all those bumps and folds in the ear have a meaning evolutionarily
cues.zh: 耳朵上那些隆起和褶皱，从进化角度看都是有意义的

cues.zh: 正在发言。

cues.en: Based on what direction the sound is coming from, sound waves bounce around inside the ear, There's some constructive and destructive interference and the result is a change in volume
cues.zh: 根据声音传来的方向，声波会在耳朵内部反射，产生相长干涉和相消干涉，结果就是音量的变化。

声音的相位也会根据声波到达耳道所走的路径而发生变化

cues.zh: 在声音频率方面，头部大小和形状也会产生类似影响。

cues.en: The way that the sound changes based on direction and frequency can be encoded in a table called the head related transfer function or HRTF.
cues.zh: 声音随方向和频率变化的方式可以被编码在一个名为头部相关传输函数或 HRTF 的表中。

cues.zh: 横轴是方向——前后左右，颜色表示该频率下声音的衰减程度

cues.en: The HRTF is as unique to an individual as a fingerprint is in fact you're looking at mine right now
cues.zh: HRTF 对每个人来说就像指纹一样独特，事实上你现在看到的就是我的

cues.en: Here's how we measure an HRTF. We've taken hundreds of people through this process.
cues.zh: 下面是我们测量 HRTF 的方法。我们已经让数百人走完了这个流程。

cues.en: We put a microphone in the subjects left and right ear canals
cues.zh: 我们把麦克风放进受试者左右耳道

cues.zh: 然后让受试者坐在由 22 个扬声器组成的阵列中央

cues.en: We then play an audio sweep from each speaker as we rotate the subject. In the course of ten or twenty minutes, we're able to sample the HRTF at over 1,000
cues.zh: 接着我们旋转受试者，同时从每个扬声器播放扫频音。在十到二十分钟内，我们就能在超过 1,000

cues.en: locations.
cues.zh: 个位置上采样 HRTF。

cues.en: Unfortunately,
cues.zh: 不幸的是，

cues.zh: 处理必须在频域而不是时域中完成。所以每个声源、每个音频 tick 都需要多次快速傅里叶变换。那是大量乘法运算

cues.en: This computational complexity was the determining factor for our strategy It meant we had to bite the bullet and design and build a custom hardware unit for three d audio.
cues.zh: 这种计算复杂度决定了我们的策略。这意味着我们必须硬着头皮，为 3D 音频设计和构建一个定制硬件单元。

cues.en: Collectively, we're referring to the hardware unit and the proprietary algorithms we run on it as Tempest
cues.zh: 我们把这些硬件单元以及在上面运行的专有算法统称为 Tempest

cues.en: three d audio tech. The meaning of three d audio and technology should be pretty obvious here. As for Tempest, I feel it really reflects our goals with audio. It suggests a certain intensity of experience and also hints at your presence within it. We're calling the hardware unit that we built the Tempest engine. It's based on AMD's GPU technology. We modified a compute unit in such a way as to make it very close to the SPUs in PlayStation three. Remember when I said that they were ideal for audio? So the Tempest engine has no caches just like an SPU.
cues.zh: 3D 音频技术。这里的 3D 音频和技术的含义应该很明显。至于 Tempest，我觉得它确实反映了我们在音频上的目标。它暗示了某种强烈的体验，也暗示了你身处其中。我们把自己构建的硬件单元称为 Tempest 引擎。它基于 AMD 的 GPU 技术。我们修改了一个计算单元，使其非常接近 PlayStation 3 中的 SPU。还记得我说过它们非常适合音频吗？所以 Tempest 引擎就像 SPU 一样没有缓存。

cues.en: All data access is via DMA

cues.en: just like an SPU.
cues.zh: 就像 SPU 一样。

cues.en: Our target was that it would have more power than a CPU,
cues.zh: 我们的目标是让它的算力超越 CPU，

cues.en: thanks to the parallelism that a GPU can achieve, and then it would be more efficient than our GPU Thanks to the SPU like architecture
cues.zh: 得益于 GPU 所能实现的并行性，然后由于采用了类似 SPU 的架构，它会比我们的 GPU 更高效

cues.en: the goal being to make possible near 100%

cues.zh: 利用率

cues.en: if we were to use the same algorithms as psvr That's enough for something like 5,000
cues.zh: 如果我们使用与 PSVR 相同的算法，这足以支持大约 5,000 个

cues.zh: 如果采用杜比等外设之类的更简单策略就能实现我们的目标，那就太棒了，但我们需要为所有人提供 3D 音频，而不仅仅是那些拥有授权条形音响之类设备的人。此外，我们需要数百个声源，而不仅仅是最多支持 32 个的声源

cues.zh: 三维音频是一个重要的学术研究课题，可以肯定地说，世界上没有人掌握所有答案，而要实现我们对三维音频的愿景，需要发明、调优或实现的算法集合极其庞大

cues.zh: 在游戏中相当复杂

cues.en: Virtual surround sound has a lot in common with three d audio on headphones But it's more complex because the left ear can hear the right speaker and vice versa We have a basic implementation of virtual surround sound up and running We're now looking at increasing the size of that sweet spot, which is to say making the area you need to be in to feel the three d effect larger,
cues.zh: 虚拟环绕声与耳机的 3D 音频有很多共同点，但它更复杂，因为左耳会听到右扬声器的声音，反之亦然。我们已经跑通了虚拟环绕声的基础实现，目前正着力扩大那个“最佳听音位”的范围，也就是让能感受到 3D 效果的活动区域变得更大。

cues.en: and we're also working to boost the sense of locality.
cues.zh: 我们同时也致力于增强声音的空间定位感。

cues.en: Headphone audio is the current gold standard for three d audio on PlayStation five, but we're going to see what we can do to bring virtual surround sound to a similar level.
cues.zh: 耳机音频是目前 PlayStation 5 上 3D 音频的黄金标准，但我们将竭尽全力，看看能否将虚拟 surround sound（环绕声）提升到相媲美的水平。

cues.en: After which, we'll start in on setups with more speakers such as six channel surround sound.
cues.zh: 之后，我们会开始讲更多声道的配置，比如六声道环绕声。

cues.en: It's now to the point where some of the PlayStation five games in development are extensively using these systems.
cues.zh: 现在已经到了这个地步：一些正在开发的 PlayStation 5 游戏已经大量使用这些系统。

cues.en: One of the game demos allows you to toggle between conventional PlayStation four style stereo audio and our new three d audio.
cues.zh: 其中一个游戏演示允许你在传统的 PlayStation 4 风格立体声音频和我们的新三维音频之间切换。

cues.en: I listened with just an ordinary pair of over the ear headphones and wow, I could feel a difference. Three audio has that dimensional feel to it. Conventional stereo audio feels smashed flat by comparison.
cues.zh: 我只用一副普通的头戴式耳机听了听，哇，我能感觉到差异。三维音频有一种空间感。相比之下，传统立体声音频感觉被压扁了。

cues.en: The improvement is obvious.
cues.zh: 改进很明显。

cues.en: So a big advancement, but have I entered matrix?
cues.zh: 所以这是很大的进步，但我进入矩阵了吗？

cues.en: Does my brain believe I'm really there? Like I was talking about earlier when I explained our target of presence.
cues.zh: 我的大脑相信我真的在那里吗？就像我之前解释我们的临场感目标时说的那样。

cues.en: Well, the answer is no, but you've probably caught on to what's missing here namely whose HRTF was being used. It wasn't mine It was the default HRTF
cues.zh: 嗯，答案是否定的，但你可能已经注意到这里缺了什么，那就是用的是谁的 HRTF。不是我的，是默认的 HRTF。

cues.en: the audio team analyzed the hundreds that they measured and chose the one they felt with the closest fit to the total game playing audience
cues.zh: 音频团队分析了他​​们测量的数百个 HRTF，选出了他们认为最贴合整体游戏玩家群体的那个。

cues.en: This shows a piece of the default HRTF on the left and my HRTF on the right you can see that the general features are much the same, but the details are quite different
cues.zh: 这里左边显示的是默认 HRTF 的一部分，右边是我的 HRTF。你可以看到整体特征大致相同，但细节差别很大。

cues.en: With the default HRTF as I said the three d audio sounds pretty great when I use my HRTF though the audio reaches a higher level of realism,
cues.zh: 用默认 HRTF 时，就像我说的，三维音频听起来相当不错。但用我的 HRTF 时，音频达到了更高的真实感水平。

cues.en: which is to say that when using headphones and my HRTF,
cues.zh: 也就是说，当使用耳机和我的 HRTF 时，

cues.en: I occasionally get fooled and even think a sound is coming from the real world when it's actually coming from the game.
cues.zh: 我偶尔会被骗，甚至以为声音来自现实世界，而实际上它来自游戏。

cues.en: A Corollary to this is that there are a few people whose HR TFs are sufficiently far from the default HR TF That's the red dot here that they can toggle between p s four style and p s five style audio and not sense much difference I've had a few people describe the PlayStation five three d audio is sounding like a bit better stereo audio Presumably they're the ones at the very edges of this diagram
cues.zh: 由此推论，有少数人的 HRTF 与默认 HRTF 差异足够大——也就是这里红点标出的位置——以至于他们在切换 PS4 风格和 PS5 风格的音频时，感觉不到太大区别。我遇到过一些人，他们形容 PlayStation 5 的 3D 音频听起来有点像更好的立体声音效。想必他们就是这个图表最边缘的那些人。

cues.en: Which means what HRTF you're using is key I'd like everyone to be able to experience what I'm experiencing But obviously it's not possible to measure the HRTF of every PlayStation user
cues.zh: 这意味着你使用的是哪种 HRTF 至关重要。我希望每个人都能体验到我所感受到的效果。但显然，为每个 PlayStation 用户测量 HRTF 是不可能的。

cues.en: that means HRTF selection
cues.zh: 这意味着 HRTF 的选择

cues.en: and synthesis are going to be big topics going forward as the Tempest technology matures
cues.zh: 和合成将成为随着 Tempest 技术走向成熟而来的重大课题。

cues.en: at PlayStation five launch. We'll be offering a choice of five HR TFs There's a simple test where you pick the one that gives you the best locality
cues.zh: 在 PlayStation 5 发售时，我们将提供五种 HRTF 供选择。有一个简单的测试，你可以从中挑选出定位感最好的那一个。

cues.en: That's just the first step though. This is an open ended research topic Maybe you'll be sending us a photo of your ear and we'll choose a neural network to pick the closest HR TF in our library Maybe you'll be sending us a video of your ears and your head and we'll make a three d model of them and synthesize the HR TF Maybe you'll play an audio game to tune your HRTF will be subtly changing it as you play and home in on the HRTF that gives you the highest score Meaning that it matches you the best
cues.zh: 但这只是第一步。这是一个开放的研究课题。也许你会给我们发一张耳朵的照片，然后我们用神经网络在我们的库中挑选出最接近的 HRTF；也许你会给我们发一段耳朵和头部的视频，然后我们为它们建立一个 3D 模型并合成 HRTF；也许你会玩一款音频游戏来调整你的 HRTF，在我们边玩边微调的过程中，锁定能给你最高分数的 HRTF，这意味着它最适合你。

cues.en: This is a journey. We'll all be taking together over the next few years Ultimately, we're committing to enabling everyone to experience that next level of realism.
cues.zh: 这是一段我们将在未来几年共同经历的旅程。最终，我们致力于让每个人都能体验到那种更高水平的逼真度。

cues.en: Hopefully,
cues.zh: 希望

cues.en: I've been able to illustrate a bit about our design and decision making process today, and why PlayStation five has the feature set that it does. Now comes the fun part We get to see how the development community takes advantage of that feature set I'm hoping for the completely unexpected will it come from audio ray tracing the capabilities of the SSD or something else I guess we'll find out soon enough
cues.zh: 今天我能为大家展示一点我们的设计和决策过程，以及为什么 PlayStation 5 会具备这些功能特性。现在是最激动人心的部分了，我们要看看开发社区将如何利用这些特性。我非常期待完全意想不到的成果——它会来自音频、光线追踪、SSD 的能力，还是其他方面？我想我们很快就会知道了。

cues.zh: 谢谢大家今天的时间
